0022600224.text: The Orlando Magic (2-7, on a four-game losing streak and 12th in the East) visit the Utah Jazz (1-9, on an eight-game losing streak and 15th in the West), with Orlando 0-4 at home and 2-3 on the road while Utah is 1-4 at home and 0-5 on the road. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda, Paolo Banchero and Tristan da Silva, and Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr., Jusuf Nurkic, Keyonte George and Lauri Markkanen. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Magic won both games in the 2025-26 season, most recently a 120-117 win in Orlando on February 7, 2026.
